notes:
Interactive overlay: press F8 in-game to switch between compact stats and a full scrollable boss checklist, press F9 to click through it
Overlay stays visible when the main window is minimized
Much faster character loading and no more stutter while streaming
Live timer keeps ticking in the OBS time file between save updates
New boss filters: hide mini-dungeon bosses, show main story bosses only, or pick your own custom set (great for boss-rush challenges with friends)
